t: This is St Mary's, a Church of England church dedicated to the Virgin Mary, on Wyndham Place at Bryanston Square. A Church of England primary school of the same name was founded right next to it. The church was designed by Sir Robert Smirke, one of the leaders of Greek Revival architecture. He is best known for the main block and façade of the British Museum, and he was a pioneer in using structural iron and concrete foundations, which made him a trusted figure in his day.
